prompt.en: A stomach contains muscle tissue, epithelial tissue, nervous tissue and blood. Explain why the stomach is an organ and not just one large tissue.

label.en: It has more than one type of tissue

level1.en: How many types of tissue are in the stomach? How many types are in one tissue?

clue.en: A tissue is a group of similar cells. The stomach has groups of cells of several different kinds.

level2Template.en: The stomach is made of more than one ___ of tissue.

accepted: more than one type of tissue

label.en: The tissues work together on one job

level1.en: What do the stomach's tissues do together that none of them can do alone?

clue.en: The muscle, lining, nerves and blood each do one part, and together they digest food.

level2Template.en: The tissues work together to carry out one job, the ___ of food.

text.en: The stomach is made of more than one type of tissue, while a tissue is a group of similar cells.
These tissues work together to carry out one job, the digestion of food, which no single tissue could do alone.
